sloka: तत् कृतेन मया प्राप्तम् रथ चर्या कृतम् सुखम् ।आशम्से त्वत् कृतेन अहम् वन वास कृतम् सुखम् ॥२-५२-५१॥
transliteration: tat kṛtena mayā prāptam ratha caryā kṛtam sukham ।āśamse tvat kṛtena aham vana vāsa kṛtam sukham ॥2-52-51॥

translations.english: By your grace I experienced the pleasure of driving your chariot, and by your grace, too, I am looking forward to deriving the pleasure of dwelling in the forest.
